items.title: Al Gallodoro Interview, 1966-05-10
items.q: Yes, I worked with him once with Paul Weitman, but it was a short-lived thing, you know.

ctx.x: We have some people from music school. How many pianists are here today? Pianists? Pianists? Could you tell us something about Gershwin? Because he...

Well, I didn't know Gershwin. Yes, I worked with him once with Paul Weitman, but it was a short-lived thing, you know. Well, as far as I'm concerned, Gershwin never wrote a bad piece of music. I think everything Gershwin wrote was gorgeous, absolutely gorgeous. From his concerto for doubles, concerto for nap.
